{"id": "c99776a9-b7c5-436c-a716-bd7368e423cb", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "Based on AWS Elemental MediaTailor documentation on `personalizationThresholdSeconds`:

**What happens when unfilled ad time exceeds the threshold:**
If the duration of underfilled (unfilled) ad time in an ad break exceeds `PersonalizationThresholdSeconds`, MediaTailor **abandons personalization of that ad break entirely** and falls back to showing the underlying content instead.

**Precondition for the threshold to apply:**
This behavior only applies to **ad replacement** (not ad insertion), in both live and VOD streams — because it depends on having an underlying content stream to fall back to. Without an underlying content stream (as in pure ad insertion scenarios), there's nothing to show in place of the unfilled ad time, so the threshold mechanism doesn't apply.", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}
